title: Framework for developing and evaluating ethical collaboration between expert and machine
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark or measure any aspects of faith or religion. The focus is on developing and ethically evaluating multi-modal AI for precision medicine, specifically for insulin management in Type 1 Diabetes.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a framework for ethical AI in a biomedical context, considering factors like demographics, comorbidities, and patient autonomy, but it does not address or analyze religious beliefs, biases, or considerations.
